name: 33316 · Ft Lauderdale, FL
findings: ZIP 33316 (Ft Lauderdale) has 144 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33316 (Ft Lauderdale) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33316 (Ft Lauderdale) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
